subject: Installing 2010 US Census packages on Shiny host beta?

messages.author: de22f3fc4c7a6af5
messages.subject: Installing 2010 US Census packages on Shiny host beta?
parts:
Would it be OK to install the UScensus2010 package and the associated packages (UScensus2010county, UScensus2010tract, &c.) which contain all the data? I ask because those packages total to something like 4.7 GB, so if that's an issue (which it probably is) then I won't even try.

Let me know! Perhaps those package installations can be shared with other Shiny beta hosting accounts to minimize overhead?

Thanks,
Mikhail

messages.subject: Re: Installing 2010 US Census packages on Shiny host beta?
parts:
I think all 4.7GB is probably too much while we're running in free beta mode. Sorry.

But now that Shiny Server is available you could set up your own Amazon EC2 instance (for example) and install whatever packages you want, for a few dollars a month.
